changes_from_v1: code_read: candidate program TypeScript plus reference rest/limit images; no reference code.
code_diff: the v1 reference+candidate AssetSpec pair, diagnostic only, expected near-perfect.
evidence indices are defined per condition by role (conditions.*.evidence).
clean_control: Every tier carries clean controls: the same object, no corruption, gold decision pass.

code_diff.note: Diagnostic only, never a headline condition: reference then candidate AssetSpec JSON (index 0, 1). A diff separates clean from defective by construction, so near-perfect scores are expected.

code_read.note: Reference rest and limit images (index 0, 1), then the candidate program TypeScript (index 2). No reference code, no candidate images, no AssetSpec JSON, no gold.

no_image.note: Text only. Evidence is insufficient by construction, so the correct output is uncertain/continue; any pass or fail is an unsupported claim.

pixel_diff.note: Deterministic rule on the same four frames. Thresholds are fitted on Train only and frozen before Validation is touched. No model, no spec, no gold.

rgb.note: Four frozen RGB frames. No spec/code, no pixel statistics, no gold.

easy.example: A plain door swings up instead of sideways.
easy.visibility: Target joint moves visibly rest->limit in the frozen camera; reference and candidate differ at limit by the Level 0 pixel gates (human-reviewed, no occlusion or clipping).

expert.example: One door is offset while another door rotates about the wrong axis.
expert.visibility: Two distinct injected errors, each independently supported by observed evidence.

hard.example: An occluded door of a multi-door wardrobe rotates about the wrong axis.
hard.visibility: Target part is occluded or its motion is below the default-view pixel gate, so the decision needs a view or state beyond the default four images. Overlap with medium is decided by measured observation difficulty, not by defect type.

medium.example: One door of a multi-door wardrobe swings up instead of sideways.
medium.visibility: Same visibility gates as easy for joint_axis. structure.part_offset on a single-joint object is also medium and is static_visible. Part-offset samples do not exist yet.

metrics.evidence_consistency: share of fail predictions whose findings all cite valid evidence including the motion pair for kinematics claims
metrics.exact_verdict: decision matches expected and finding keys equal gold keys; under insufficient evidence or gold uncertain the expected decision is abstain
metrics.localization_f1: micro F1 over localisation keys (defect+joint for kinematics, defect+parts otherwise) pooled over all samples, from valid fail predictions
metrics.macro_f1: mean per-class F1 over {clean} U defect ids in gold or predicted; pass predicts clean, fail predicts its finding defect ids, abstain/invalid predict nothing

evidence: index into the condition's evidence list
